rulebook.title: World Taekwondo Competition Rules & Interpretation (Olympic sparring, kyorugi)
rulebook.text_used: written from general knowledge of the WT competition rules; worldtaekwondo.org was not reachable from this session, so the wording and point values were not re-checked against the current edition. References are section names, because the article numbers change between editions.

contest_area_m.note: Olympic events use an octagon about 8 m across inside a larger square mat

points.note: values of recent editions; each gam-jeom gives the opponent 1 point

scene.text: White dobok with a belt; electronic trunk protector and headgear in the athlete's colour, red (hong) or blue (chung); forearm and shin guards, gloves, sensor socks, groin guard and mouthguard, all worn under or over the dobok as the rules require.
Flat, non-slip mat; the contest area is marked as an octagon (Olympic events) or a square, with a boundary line.
One referee on the mat in a uniform; judges and a video-replay jury off the mat; coaches seated at the corners.
Punches with the knuckles of a tightly clenched fist, only to the trunk protector; kicks with the foot below the ankle bone, to the trunk protector or to the head above the collar bone.

fouls.title: Kick lands with the foot on the trunk protector
fouls.text: A kick scores only when the part of the foot below the ankle bone lands on a permitted area; the trunk protector may be attacked by fist and foot, but not the spine.
fouls.legal: the kicking foot lands on the front or side of the trunk protector

fouls.rule: Prohibited acts (gam-jeom): attacking below the waist
fouls.title: Attacking below the waist
fouls.text: Kicking or attacking the opponent below the waist is a gam-jeom (penalty point to the opponent).
fouls.legal: the kicking foot is above the opponent's waist
avoid: kick to the opponent's leg or knee

fouls.rule: Prohibited acts (gam-jeom): hitting the head with the hand
fouls.title: Hand attack to the face
fouls.text: Hitting the opponent's head or face with the hand is a gam-jeom; the head may be attacked only by kicks.
fouls.legal: neither fist is on the opponent's face

fouls.title: Grabbing or pushing
fouls.text: Grabbing or holding the opponent or the opponent's leg or dobok, and pushing the opponent with the hands or body, are gam-jeom.

fouls.rule: Prohibited acts (gam-jeom): knee and head attacks
fouls.title: Kneeing or head butting
fouls.text: Attacking with the knee or butting with the head is a gam-jeom.

fouls.rule: Prohibited acts (gam-jeom): crossing the boundary line
fouls.title: Stepping out of the contest area
fouls.text: Stepping out over the boundary line of the contest area is a gam-jeom, and so is falling down.
avoid: athlete standing outside the contest area line
